title: Adds expired status for Issuing Authorizations
changed: authorizations expired by Stripe move from reversed to expired
reason: Equality checks against an old value (`x.field === <old value>`) are not enumChecks, so a renamed or replaced value goes unreported in every mode.

parts.how: Only with fullDiff: compareOpenApi drops Stripe response enum additions (openResponseEnums) and switchedEnumAdditions (openapi-diff.ts) re-adds the new value where the code switches over the field or assigns it to `never` (analyzer.ts enumChecks). unmappedBreakingChanges keeps that entry, so scanReviewReason (workflow.ts) stops the run for review and publication is blocked. Other reads need no edit (AGENTS.md: Stripe response enum additions block only where the code switches over the field). Without fullDiff nothing is reported.
